name: CITY COUNCIL MEETING
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
May 24, 2022 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.

Councilmember De Ruse

Mayor Eng
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PRESENTATION OF AWARDS TO LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION SCHOLARSHIP RECIPIENTS - It is recommended the City Council present Certificates of Recognition, and the Board of Directors of the La Mirada Community Foundation present scholarship checks to the Bob Jenkins Community Service Scholarship recipients Amber Cheng, Melissa Dang, Marina Saffold, Alex Santiago, Taylor Whisler and Natalia Zuniga and STEM Scholarship recipients Jaidyn Fujii and Hannah Stelter.
5.1 Presentation of Foundation Scholarships
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT: (Any information or materials provided during Public Comments are recorded in the minutes and are subject to public disclosure under the Public Records Act. The speaker is requested, but is not required, to orally state his or her name and/or address for purposes of recording the information accurately in the minutes. If the speaker declines to provide his or her name, address, and other relevant information, the records will so indicate. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council.)
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
APPOINTMENTS TO THE LA MIRADA SENIOR COUNCIL - It is recommended the City Council appoint Mary Hall and Lori Chimberoff to the La Mirada Senior Council for terms ending in June 2023.
7.1 Appointmets to Senior Council
7.2
REAPPOINTMENTS TO THE PUBLIC SAFETY AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION AND THE SENIOR COUNCIL - It is recommended the City Council reappoint John Ojeisekhoba to the Public Safety and Traffic Commission for a term expiring in June 2024 and reappoint Larry McCollum to the Senior Council for a term expiring in June 2023.
7.2 Reappointments
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of May 10, 2022 and the regular City Council meeting of May 10, 2022.
8.1 Minutes of 5-10-22 SS
8.1 Minutes of 5-10-22 CC
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated May 24, 2022 in the total amount of $1,973,976.27.
8.2 Warrant Register
8.3
EXTENSION TO THE AGREEMENT WITH ACTORS THEATER SERIES, INC. FOR THE PRODUCTION AND PRESENTATION OF THEATRICAL PERFORMANCES AT LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS - It is recommended the City Council approve a one-year extension to the existing agreement between the City and Actors Theater Series, Inc. for the production and presentation of theatrical performances at La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts and authorize the Mayor to execute the extension on behalf of the City.
8.3 Extension of the Agreement with ATS
8.4
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING APRIL 2022 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending April 2022.
8.4 Investment Report
8.5
PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH PHIL MARTIN AND ASSOCIATES FOR THE PREPARATION OF AN INITIAL STUDY AND MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION ENVIRONMENTAL ANALYSIS - It is recommended the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute a Professional Services Agreement with Phil Martin and Associates for the preparation of a complete and comprehensive Initial Study and Mitigated Negative Declaration environmental assessment in an amount not to exceed $82,000.00 and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work that may be required to complete the environmental assessment up to 15% of the authorized proposal amount.
8.5 Agreement with Phil Martin & Associates
9.
